To:Mei-Lin Chao <chao@puffinandpine.com>
From:Rafael Ortega <r.ortega@puffinandpine.com>
Date:22 February
Subject:Expansion Update

Dear Ms. Chao,

Following our successful expansion into Chile and Peru, Puffin & Pine is getting ready to open four new shops in Spain later this year. However, we still need to find a local supplier of wooden puzzles, building blocks, and painted figures. Like the rest of our range, these products must contain no plastic parts.

As our supplier-relations manager for South America, you have built strong relationships with manufacturers in that market. I would like to know whether any of your current vendors distribute in Europe. If so, please send their contact details directly to me. I will review them with our purchasing team.

Sincerely,
Rafael Ortega
Operations Director
